purpose: 泛行业较高胜率研究池，任何模型使用同一成功标签与验收标准
label: industry_return > 0 AND industry_return - benchmark_return > 0
unknown_policy: not zero; retain total, immature, missing-path counts and bounds
repeat_event_policy: false_to_true_on_consecutive_observed_weeks; continuous membership not repeated admission; unknown boundary separate; 126-session industry cooldown as sensitivity
validation: chronological frozen predictions, only labels matured before fitting/calibration; time-block uncertainty; no random train-test split
failure_action: do not lower threshold or select another horizon after observing results; reflect and register a new experiment version
limits: Historical data already examined. These are working research targets, not achieved efficacy, guaranteed probabilities, user-approved portfolio constraints, or forward certification.
